# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Start changeover to Style B
# writes, in order: POST /api/processes/1/changeover/start
### POST /api/processes/1/changeover/start  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: GET /api/core-nodes
    new text: .layer-scrim h2: The changeover to Style B did not start
    new text: .layer-scrim p: the Edge refused it
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn: Cancel
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn.btn-primary: Close
    notice: error "the Edge refused it"
    sheet: open "The changeover to Style B did not start", no status, OK "Close" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/processes/1/changeover/start  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: GET /api/core-nodes
    new text: .layer-scrim h2: The changeover to Style B did not start
    new text: .layer-scrim p: Server error (500)
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn: Cancel
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn.btn-primary: Close
    notice: error "Server error (500)"
    sheet: open "The changeover to Style B did not start", no status, OK "Close" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/processes/1/changeover/start  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: GET /api/core-nodes
    new text: .layer-scrim h2: The changeover to Style B did not start
    new text: .layer-scrim p: No answer from the server
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn: Cancel
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn.btn-primary: Close
    notice: error "No answer from the server"
    sheet: open "The changeover to Style B did not start", no status, OK "Close" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none

## Pin to Style B
# writes, in order: POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid
### POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: the Edge refused it
    notice: error "the Edge refused it"
    sheet: open "Pin CATID CAT-Q to Style B?", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Pin" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid · GET /api/catid-health · GET /api/processes/1/catid-health → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: Server error (500)
    notice: error "Server error (500)"
    sheet: open "Pin CATID CAT-Q to Style B?", status "Server error (500)" (bad), OK "Pin" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid · GET /api/catid-health · GET /api/processes/1/catid-health → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: No answer from the server
    notice: error "No answer from the server"
    sheet: open "Pin CATID CAT-Q to Style B?", status "No answer from the server" (bad), OK "Pin" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid · GET /api/catid-health · GET /api/processes/1/catid-health → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root span.notice-text: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root a.notice-action: Sign in
    notice: error "Signed out" (sticky) · Sign in → /login?next=%2Fprocesses
    sheet: open "Pin CATID CAT-Q to Style B?", status "Signed out" (bad), OK "Pin" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid → sheet: open "Pin CATID CAT-Q to Style B?", status "Signed out" (bad), OK "Pin" enabled

    notice: error "Server error (500)"

    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none

    then: GET /api/core-nodes

    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn: Cancel
    new text: .layer-scrim button.btn.btn-primary: Close
